Introduction

Lawyer. Legal operator. Problem solver.

I am a Nigerian-qualified lawyer and in-house legal professional with practical experience supporting litigation, legal operations, compliance, contract review, legal research and stakeholder coordination within the banking sector.

In my current role at Access Bank Plc, I work with senior legal professionals and business stakeholders on matters involving litigation, court processes, external solicitors, regulatory issues, customer-account restrictions, legal documentation and risk mitigation.

What interests me about legal operations is the space between the legal issue and the work required to move it forward: organising information, tracking matters, following up with stakeholders, managing documents and making sure deadlines and actions do not get lost.

I am particularly interested in remote legal support roles where strong legal knowledge, organisation, written communication, confidentiality and independent execution matter.
